continuity_scope: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition (Beamdog, 2014), English product/manual baseline. The pass is limited to Beamdog's packaged Enhanced Edition: Original Icewind Dale campaign, Heart of Winter, Trials of the Luremaster, and Beamdog-restored cut quest content. It does not merge the 2000 Black Isle original release, later mods, Icewind Dale II, other Forgotten Realms products, or unverified external transcripts.
work_or_witnesses: Beamdog: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition official product page
Beamdog: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition Feature Guide
coverage_rule: Zero-character evidence-constrained pass. Beamdog's selected first-party product page, feature guide, and manual define setting, edition, campaign, expansion, and player-party mechanics but do not provide a reproducible set of individually described named dramatic NPCs with claim-specific dialogue/journal locators. Player-created party members are excluded by design. Rather than import fan-wiki or community-transcript claims, this pass records only source terms and leaves character and relationship arrays empty.
omissions: All player-created party members and every player-selected name, race, class, kit, biography, alignment, statistics, equipment, and choice.

All named NPCs, villains, quest-givers, companions, monsters, and deities because no selected first-party witness provides an individually sufficient claim-specific character profile or direct in-game dialogue/journal locator.
Factions, peoples, monsters, artifacts, places, spells, classes, kits, D&D rules, interface features, and quests as character nodes.

The original Black Isle/Interplay release as a separate edition, Icewind Dale II, post-release mods, community fixes, fan transcripts, wikis, walkthroughs, novels, tabletop references, and other Forgotten Realms works.
uncertainties: The game contains named NPC dialogue and journal material, but no official text extract with fine dialogue/journal locators was accessible in the selected evidence set. This audit deliberately does not reconstruct those claims from community sources.

Enhanced Edition bundles the original campaign, both expansions, and restored cut content. This source record identifies the package but does not claim that original-release and Enhanced Edition text/encounter behavior are identical.

The product is licensed Dungeons & Dragons/Forgotten Realms material. Beamdog's materials are authoritative for Enhanced Edition packaging and presentation, not an exhaustive hierarchy for all tabletop setting canon.

English terminology is preserved; localization variants are not compared. Branching party composition, quest decisions, character creation, difficulty, and multiplayer mean a player run does not provide a single fixed adventuring party.
No plot-resolution claims are made; this zero-character evidence boundary avoids unmarked spoilers.
evidence_basis: First-party Beamdog product page and official Beamdog manuals only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, forum post, community transcript, walkthrough, or secondary orientation source is used as canonical evidence.

citations.locator: Features and Story sections; copyright line

Beamdog's account of preserving the story while restoring cut content and including Heart of Winter and Trials of the Luremaster
